q: In a credit card transaction, the bank that issued the card to the customer is called the:
exp: Issuer = cardholder bank; acquirer = merchant bank; the card network sits between them.

q: In a cellular network, the process of transferring an ongoing call from one base station to another is called:
exp: Handoff (handover) maintains a call as the user moves between cells.

q: Which of the following is a classic example of a C2C e-commerce platform?
exp: OLX is an online classifieds site where consumers sell to other consumers.

q: Compared with barcodes, RFID tags can be read:
options: Only after being scanned by a laser at 1 cm
Without a direct line of sight
exp: Radio waves do not need line-of-sight reading.

q: Which of the following is an open-source cloud computing platform used to build IaaS clouds?
exp: OpenStack is an open-source IaaS platform.

q: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of a public blockchain?
options: Controlled by a single central authority
exp: Public blockchains have no single controlling authority.

q: UMANG, the mobile app for government services, stands for:
options: Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance
Universal Mobile App for National Government
United Mobile Access for New Governance
Unique Mobile Application for National Growth
exp: UMANG provides many central and state e-services on a single platform.

q: A firewall is best described as a system that:
options: Speeds up a network by caching web pages
Removes all viruses stored inside the computers
Converts domain names to IP addresses
Filters traffic between a trusted network and an untrusted network according to rules
exp: A firewall enforces access rules at the boundary; it does not clean existing infections or resolve names.

q: Which of the following is an IoT cloud platform?
exp: AWS IoT Core, Azure IoT Hub and Google Cloud IoT are cloud platforms for connecting and managing devices.

q: In MS Word, which shortcut inserts a page break?
exp: Ctrl+Enter inserts a page break; Shift+Enter inserts a line break.

q: What is the ASCII code (decimal) of the capital letter 'D', given that 'A' is 65?
exp: A=65, B=66, C=67, D=68; 100 is the code of lowercase 'd'.

q: Which cryptographic method uses a single shared secret key for both encryption and decryption?
exp: AES/DES are symmetric: same key at both ends. RSA is asymmetric; hashes use no key.

q: Which Indian law mainly deals with cybercrime and electronic commerce?
exp: The IT Act, 2000 provides legal recognition to e-records and defines cyber offences.

q: NB-IoT (Narrowband IoT) operates in:
exp: NB-IoT is a 3GPP LPWAN technology deployed in licensed cellular bands.

q: 'Cloud bursting' refers to:
options: Deleting all data from a cloud
A sudden failure of all data centres
Temporarily using public cloud resources when private cloud capacity is exhausted
exp: It is a hybrid cloud technique for handling demand spikes.

q: In IoT, a smartphone commonly acts as:
options: Only a power source for sensors
A user interface and controller (and sometimes a gateway) for IoT devices over BLE, NFC or Wi-Fi
A replacement for the IPv6 protocol
exp: Smartphones run control apps for smart devices and can relay data to the cloud.

q: The Android operating system is based on which kernel?
exp: Android is built on the Linux kernel.

q: Which statement about RTGS in India is correct?
options: It settles high-value payments in real time on a gross basis
It settles payments in half-hourly batches on a net basis
It is used only for payments below ₹1000
It works only for card payments
exp: RTGS = Real Time Gross Settlement, meant for large-value transfers.

q: The padlock symbol and 'https' in a browser's address bar indicate that:
options: The website is owned by the government
Data between browser and server is encrypted using TLS/SSL
The computer is free of viruses
exp: HTTPS uses TLS/SSL to encrypt communication.

q: Which of the following is an international standard for Electronic Data Interchange?
exp: UN/EDIFACT (and ANSI X12 in the USA) are EDI message standards.

q: The JAM trinity, used for direct benefit transfer in India, stands for:
exp: JAM links Jan Dhan bank accounts, Aadhaar identity and mobile numbers.

q: Which of the following helps reduce power consumption in a data centre?
options: Running every server at idle continuously
Installing more standalone physical servers for each application
exp: Virtualization lets fewer physical servers run many workloads, saving power.

q: Which of the following is the best example of a digital library repository?
options: Shodhganga, the repository of Indian theses
A pen drive without any metadata
exp: Shodhganga (INFLIBNET) is an Indian digital repository of PhD theses.

q: Which IEEE standard describes Bluetooth-type wireless personal area networking?
exp: 802.15.1 was the basis of Bluetooth, while 802.15.4 is used by ZigBee.

q: The SHA-256 hash function produces a hash value of:
exp: SHA-256 gives a 256-bit digest, used in Bitcoin.

q: VoLTE stands for:
exp: VoLTE carries voice calls as data over 4G LTE networks.

q: A small, subject-specific subset of a data warehouse built for one department (for example marketing) is called a:
exp: A data mart serves a single department; the enterprise-wide store is the data warehouse.

q: In an RFID system, the device that sends radio signals to power a passive tag and reads its ID is the:
exp: A passive tag has no battery; the reader energises it and reads the stored ID.

q: A man-in-the-middle attack means that the attacker:
options: Secretly intercepts and possibly alters communication between two parties
Guesses a password with a dictionary
Copies a file with a virus
exp: MITM sits between sender and receiver; flooding is DoS and password guessing is brute force/dictionary attack.

q: Netiquette refers to:
options: Accepted rules of polite and responsible behaviour on the internet
exp: Netiquette is network etiquette for online conduct.

q: Which essential cloud characteristic allows the provider to meter usage and bill customers on a pay-as-you-go basis?
exp: Measured service means usage is monitored and billed accordingly.

q: A freelance designer offers logo-design services to companies through an online marketplace. This model is:
exp: An individual offering a service to businesses is consumer-to-business.

q: Compared with consumer IoT, Industrial IoT places greater emphasis on:
exp: IIoT failures can cause safety hazards and production loss, so reliability, determinism and security are priorities.
